status: post-outcome paired-support mechanism attribution; frozen before paired collapsed-vs-state output
role: diagnose whether the previously observed Nyctalus HMM-state attenuation reflects state information itself rather than support loss; cannot restore prospective status

hypothesis_origin.rationale: Determine whether adding source HMM state removes same-individual predictive information on identical state-supported target events, rather than merely reducing evaluable support.

fixed_context.vertical_centering: full retained source-track median before state filtering

paired_estimand.event_pool: only events with source move_state in {ARM, COM}; both models use this identical event pool
paired_estimand.state_model: P(centered z | 5-km cell x source HMM move_state)
paired_estimand.collapsed_model: P(centered z | 5-km cell), trained from the identical ARM/COM event pool with state collapsed
paired_estimand.target_support: score only target events whose full cell x state stratum is supported in both self and other state profiles and whose collapsed cell is supported in both collapsed profiles
paired_estimand.target_matching: both models are scored on exactly the same state-model-supported target events
paired_estimand.other_weighting: pool source tracks within each other bat, then equal-weight other bats within cohort
paired_estimand.target_aggregation: equal target track within bat, then equal bat
paired_estimand.paired_increment: state-conditioned identity gain minus collapsed identity gain; negative values indicate attenuation after state conditioning

calibration.preserve: track x-y-state-centered-z block and exact per-cohort track-count multiset per identity
calibration.primary_test: observed paired state increment < permutation null mean and one-sided p(null <= observed) <= 0.05

interpretation_matrix.attenuation_PASS: Source HMM state removes more same-individual predictive advantage than expected on identical target support, supporting behavioural-state allocation as a contributor in Nyctalus.
interpretation_matrix.attenuation_FAIL: The apparent HMM-state attenuation is not distinguishable from support-matched permutation expectation; support loss / finite-sample precision remains a viable explanation.

claim_boundary: This test is post-outcome mechanism localization, not confirmatory discovery or external prospective replication.
ARM/COM are source-study HMM behavioural proxies, not exact resource identity.
A significant negative paired increment would support state-linked organization as a contributor, not prove it is the sole mechanism.
A non-significant paired increment would not prove state is irrelevant; it would show the existing state-vs-primary contrast does not identify state causally.
No alternative state filter, grid, event minimum, vertical bins, B, seed or tail direction may be selected after output.
